independent_evidence_unit: sha256 of the reviewed excerpt within a goal/url/language context

feedback_semantics.useful: The owner says this note helped; it does not assert factual truth.
feedback_semantics.not_useful: The owner says this note did not help; it does not assert the subject is irrelevant.
feedback_semantics.duplicate_excerpt_different_note: audited feedback row; no additional evidence unit or policy version
feedback_semantics.changed_rating_same_note: one revision replaces the excerpt evidence count
feedback_semantics.contradictory_rating_different_note_same: latest effective rating for that excerpt
feedback_semantics.factual_support: separate exact-quote validation; never inferred from usefulness

recovery.mechanism: bounded periodic re-evaluation plus explicit owner correction
recovery.trigger: three consecutive no-action observations in the same context
recovery.probe_authority: one snapshot only; still requires grant, reviewed hash and Governor budget
recovery.owner_correction: reset suppression counter and record correction; never broadens permission

native_harness.backend: isolated current-branch uvicorn on a free loopback port
native_harness.browser: system Chrome via Playwright, fresh profile
native_harness.extension: temporary unpacked copy with test-only loopback config
native_harness.side_panel: docked side-panel target was not produced; extension page was used

meta_ceiling.approval: required separately; not granted by this milestone
